description: DriveService (plan §11.1, §15.2; session A 2026-10-15) on a real executor, event bus, problem service and EngineClock over a manual clock (it starts at 2026-10-02T20:00:00.000Z). Fakes: Makemkv.scanDrives gives makemkv (DRV lines, through Robot.parseLine and MakemkvDrive.from) or fails with scanFails {code, params}; DeviceMonitor.currentDrives gives os [{device, identification, mountPath}] and start keeps the sink; DriveControl.probeContent says video, eject fails with ejectFails {code, params} when given, closeTray works; DriveRepository holds stored (rows: id, identification, model, lastDevice, configId, firstSeenAt, lastSeenAt). config is the configuration document (ConfigCodec.decode; default {version: 3}). Calls are recorded in order: 'monitor.start', 'scan', 'probe <device>', 'eject <device>', 'closeTray <device>'. Ops, each on the executor and settled (executor activity 0) before the next: 'start' (DriveService.start); set {makemkv?, os?, scanFails? (null: scans work again)} (what later scans see; no scan); device {type: driveAppeared | driveVanished | mediaArrived | mediaRemoved | trayOpened | mounted | unmounted, device, path?} (the monitor's sink, from another thread); advance (seconds); lease {drives [{drive, job}], acquisitions} (publishes leaseChanged, job counts 0); config (a new document: the source's, then configChanged); rescan; eject (a drive id); closeTray (a drive id); closeAll; 'drives' (DriveService.drives); find (a drive id: DriveLookup.find). Expect: results (one per op: the drives (dtos.json Drive, optional members left out when absent), find's DriveLocation {makemkvIndex, device, configId, generation, label, flags (raw)} or null, a command's {error {code, params}} when it failed; null otherwise); events (every driveChanged, driveRemoved, mediumArrived, mediumRemoved, problemRaised, problemCleared, with its seq and at, in order; the leaseChanged and configChanged the harness publishes take seqs too); calls (exactly); problems (the active ones at the end, as dtos.json Problem); stored (the rows at the end, by id). An expectation left out isn't checked.
